title: IPC is going to conduct PT round 04/2025 for Identification by IR & Chromatographic Purity by HPLC in Chemical Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals)
bodyHtml:
IPC is going to conduct PT round 04/2025 for Identification by IR & Chromatographic Purity by HPLC in Chemical Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals). You are requested to find the attached Registration form and send your consent with filled registration form by e-mail at qualityassurance-ipc@gov.in on or before 06th February 2026.

Click here to download Registration formPDF (opens in a new tab)
